# Codex Pull Request Review

Review this pull request in a code-review stance. Prioritize bugs, behavioral regressions, security issues, missing tests, and mismatches with the repository instructions in `AGENTS.md`.

Keep the response concise and actionable:

- Lead with findings ordered by severity.
- Include exact file and line references when possible.
- If there are no blocking findings, say so clearly and mention any residual test risk.
- Avoid broad style commentary unless it affects correctness or maintainability.
